_comment: PreToolUse matcher includes BOTH 'Task' and 'Agent': the sub-agent tool is named Task in
Claude Code, and the old matcher only listed Agent, so sub-agent dispatch — the loop the
anti-loop contract most wants caught — was never guarded.
The hook command uses python3. On the Windows master that binary is often absent, in which
case the hook silently does not run (RUNBOOK). The guard is defence in depth, not a
The allowlist covers the commands the RUNBOOK actually documents, including per-project
helper scripts under projects/*/docs/, which used to prompt on every call.
